Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.  However, if you first activate  and this card is removed from the trash, the other effects on this card that were pending activation can no longer activate.
Card Q&A.q: Multiple effects trigger when this card is deleted. In what order can they be activated?

Card Q&A.a: The player that activated this card's effect.  The cards to return and their order are chosen by the player that activated this effect, then they are returned to the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Which player chooses the cards that are to be returned from my opponent’s trash to the deck by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

I chose 2 cards including a Digi-Egg card from my opponent's trash for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. At such times, the rules place the Digi-Egg card at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck when it would be returned to the deck, but is this effect's "by" condition met?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.  In order for the conditions for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to be met, you must return 2 cards from your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return 1 card from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't activate it.  When a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves its current area while activation is pending, the effect can no longer be activated.  In this case, the deleted card's [On Deletion] effect triggers, but it's removed from the trash before the effect can activate.
Card Q&A.q: I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to delete an opponent's Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect, and I used the part of the effect after "then" to return that card from their trash to the bottom of the deck.  Can that deleted card's [On Deletion] effect activate at such times?

Card Q&A.a: Its DP is reduced by 15000.  You count the total number of colors on the returned cards.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return 1 red and blue card and 1 blue and yellow card from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, what is the DP reduction to 1 of my opponent's Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.
Card Q&A.q: When I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect and my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area due to processing the 1st part, an immediate-type effect such as "when [...] would leave" removes this card from the battle area.After that, can I process the part of the effect following after "then" in this card's effect?

Effect: ＜Piercing＞ ＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Ascension＞ (When this Digimon is deleted, you may place this card as the top security card.)

[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon. Then, by returning 2 cards from their trash to the bottom of the deck, for the turn, this Digimon gets +6000 DP and, to 1 of their Digimon, give -5000 DP for each of those returned cards' colors.
[On Deletion] You may return 1 [TB] trait card from your trash to the hand. Then, you may play 1 level 5 or lower [TB] trait Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost.
